title: Prove closure-bound activation in a disposable sandbox
goal: After T002 is terminal and independently reviewed, consume its exact immutable implementation revision to prove the managed Nix/NixOS build-and-activation contract end to end inside an exclusively reserved disposable non-production sandbox: materialize the exact reviewed Git revision as a content-addressed whole-source snapshot, realize an exact closure only from that immutable snapshot, activate only that approved closure, read it back independently, prove denied paths are effect-free and prove rollback without touching the productive Heim-PC.

approval.note: Runtime mutation is authorized only inside the exclusively reserved disposable service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox and only after T002 is terminal and its exact implementation revision is independently reviewed. The narrow T002 implementation paths are externally reserved while the proof is bound, while every Nix evaluation/build input is consumed from a content-addressed immutable whole-source snapshot materialized from the exact reviewed Git commit inside the exclusive sandbox. After snapshot binding, use of the mutable Heim-PC checkout, a branch, a re-resolved lock or an unpinned remote source fails closed. Productive Heim-PC activation, boot state, production storage, EFI, Secure-Boot, firmware and reboot remain outside this authority.

acceptance.assertion: Before any runtime effect, the run is bound to the exact terminal T002 source revision and reviewed implementation evidence, and holds external reservations for nixos/deployment, scripts/managed_nix.py and tests/test_managed_nix.py for the whole proof; any dirty state, revision drift, lease loss or missing review fails closed.

Before managed build or activation, the exact reviewed T002 terminal Git commit is materialized inside the exclusive activation sandbox as a content-addressed immutable whole-source snapshot. Evidence binds the Git commit and tree identity, snapshot digest, Control Release Set and lock/input identity. All flake/lock, host/user modules, system configuration and other Nix build inputs are read only from this snapshot; after binding, any fallback to /home/alex/repos/heim-pc, a branch, a mutable lock or an unpinned remote source fails closed before effect.

Before any runtime effect, the run holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox claim and independently proves that the target is disposable and isolated from the productive Heim-PC runtime, production storage, EFI, firmware and persistent boot state.

Using only the hash-bound immutable whole-source snapshot and receipt-bound inputs, a managed sandbox build realizes an immutable NixOS system closure and emits a receipt binding exact source commit/tree, snapshot digest, Control Release Set, effect class and closure.

Sandbox activation consumes only the reviewed managed-build receipt bound to the exact immutable source snapshot, source revision, system closure, sandbox target and Activation effect class; mutable source, branch names or caller-supplied closure strings alone cannot authorize activation.

Missing, stale, mismatched or unauthorized source/review/snapshot/receipt/target authority is rejected before runtime mutation, and evidence proves the denied path leaves the sandbox activation state unchanged.
Independent live readback after authorized sandbox activation proves the running/booted system closure exactly equals the approved closure from the bound receipt.

Observed activation performs no Git, branch, lock or remote-input reevaluation after the reviewed build receipt is fixed; runtime evidence demonstrates closure selection remains receipt-bound and no mutable Heim-PC checkout is read.
Inside the same disposable sandbox, rollback consumes the receipt-bound prior closure/recovery path and independent readback proves the expected rollback closure without mutable-source reevaluation.

This task terminates without productive nixos-rebuild switch, productive boot activation, production storage/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, Heim-PC reboot or any equivalent production cutover effect.
The exact source-snapshot, sandbox build, activation, readback, denied-path and rollback evidence is independently reviewed before T004 is considered terminal.
